title: Uncleared Check and Bank-Transfer Payments on Insured Plan of Care Credits
content:
**Patient Accounts Manual, cashiering — Insured Plan of Care.** Money not yet cleared is held back from the credit standing on a plan. Days are counted as calendar days from the date the payment was received, that date itself being day zero.

1. Where the most recent check payment on the plan was received fewer than the **10** check clearing days ago, its amount is held.
2. Where no check payment is that recent but the most recent bank-transfer (ACH) payment was received fewer than the **5** bank-transfer clearing days ago, its amount is held.
3. Otherwise nothing is held for uncleared funds.

The amount held is taken off the credit together with any other amount held back from it, and what remains is never below zero.

## Boundary table (hypothetical, today 2026-06-15)

| Most recent check payment received | Day count | Most recent bank-transfer payment received | Day count | Held |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-06-06, $150.00 | 9 | — | — | $150.00 (the check) |
| 2026-06-05, $150.00 | 10 | 2026-06-11, $60.00 | 4 | $60.00 (the bank transfer) |
| 2026-06-05, $150.00 | 10 | 2026-06-10, $60.00 | 5 | Nothing |
| none | — | 2026-06-12, $60.00 | 3 | $60.00 |

Only the most recent check payment, or failing that the most recent bank-transfer payment, is held; card, cash and other payments are not held on this basis.
